items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Yeah, I played with Clay Giles. He had a brother they called Oscar Giles.

ctx.x: Well, now, you say you played with his brother, huh? Were you the one who was saying that?
Yeah, I played with Clay Giles. He had a brother they called Oscar Giles.
Is that Albert Giles' uncle or father?
